Business Definition: A musical work or Tempo record representing a Song, Production, or Episode, distinguished by Song ID and Song Sequence ID.
Business Context / Rule: Use Song ID together with Song Sequence ID when the business process distinguishes a primary Song/Production from an Episode or other sequence record.

Business Definition: Identifies a record within a Song ID. Sequence zero generally represents the primary Song or Production, while greater sequences can represent Episodes.
Business Context / Rule: Sequence zero generally represents the primary Song or Production. For episodic content, sequences greater than zero represent Episodes.

Business Definition: A Film, television, or other audiovisual production represented by a Tempo Song record at sequence zero.
Business Context / Rule: Production records are represented at sequence zero and can provide inherited assignments to Episodes when no Episode-specific assignment exists.

Business Definition: A sequence-level record associated with a parent episodic Production. Episode-specific assignments take precedence over inherited Production assignments.
Business Context / Rule: Episode-specific Client or Contract assignments take precedence. If no Episode assignment exists, inherit the sequence-zero Production assignment.

Business Definition: Ownership and administration hierarchy connecting Songs, Writers, Publishers, Contracts, and Territories.
Business Context / Rule: Interpret ownership in the applicable Song IP Territory and follow the Writer-to-Publisher-to-Contract hierarchy.

Business Definition: Writer compositional contribution to a Song within a territorial ownership context.
Business Context / Rule: Review at Song and IP Territory grain. Contributions are expected to represent the Writer composition split; do not duplicate the percentage across multiple Publisher rows.

Business Definition: Indicates whether SMP controls or administers the applicable Writer interest.
Business Context / Rule: Use to distinguish interests administered or controlled by SMP from non-controlled interests.

Business Definition: Territorial context under which the Song ownership and administration chain applies.
Business Context / Rule: Ownership and administration can differ by territory; always include the IP Territory when evaluating Song shares.

Business Definition: Effective Contract territory for a Song after considering Song-level territorial overrides.
Business Context / Rule: This is the Contract territory after applying Song-specific territorial rules.

Business Definition: Final included or excluded territory for a Song and Contract. Song-level overrides take precedence over Contract-level definitions.
Business Context / Rule: Song-level territorial overrides take precedence over Contract-level inclusions and exclusions.

Business Definition: Writer-level Song ownership summary by Territory and Contract; Publishers are concatenated to prevent duplicate Writer reporting.
Business Context / Rule: Use for Writer-level reporting. Publisher names are aggregated specifically to prevent double-counting Writer contribution.

Business Definition: Detailed Publisher-level Song IP-chain representation, closely reflecting the Tempo ownership interface.
Business Context / Rule: Use when Publisher-level IP-chain or hierarchy detail is required. Aggregating without respecting its detailed grain may duplicate Writer shares.

Business Definition: Additional title associated with a Song, including language, script, title type, and country attributes.
Business Context / Rule: A Song may have multiple alternate titles and country associations; reporting grain is alternate title plus associated country.

Business Definition: Alternate title in the local language of the Song Originating Office.
Business Context / Rule: Y indicates the title is in the local language of the Song Originating Office.

Business Definition: International Standard Recording Code associated with a recording of a Song; Tempo generally stores compact format without dashes.
Business Context / Rule: Treat as a recording identifier, not a musical-work identifier. Tempo normally uses the compact 12-character format without dashes.

Business Definition: International Standard Musical Work Code identifying a musical composition.
Business Context / Rule: Treat as a musical-work identifier. Where multiple values exist, preferred and conflict indicators should guide use.

Business Definition: Work identifier assigned by a collection society.
Business Context / Rule: Society Work Numbers are society-specific; include the Society when using the identifier.

Business Definition: Common Works Registration process used to submit Song and ownership information and receive acknowledgements.
Business Context / Rule: CWR records support registration submission and acknowledgement processing with societies.

Business Definition: Society or organization receiving CWR registration information.
Business Context / Rule: Recipient configuration determines the society, supported CWR version, and applicable registration-processing rules.

Business Definition: A CWR ACK (Acknowledgement) transaction is the formal recipient response to a submitted registration. It communicates transaction status, processing outcomes, validation messages, recipient-assigned identifiers, and where applicable conflict information. First and second acknowledgements may contain different dates, status codes, messages and identifiers.
Business Context / Rule: First and second acknowledgements can carry distinct dates, statuses, files, and messages; retain acknowledgement level when analyzing responses.

Business Definition: A structured validation message returned by a recipient through a CWR MSG record during acknowledgement processing. The message identifies the record type being validated, severity level, validation rule, and explanatory text describing why an acknowledgement outcome occurred. The MSG record supplements the ACK Transaction Status by explaining the reason for acceptance, rejection, conflict, warning, or validation failure.
Business Context / Rule: CWR Validation Messages should be interpreted together with the associated ACK Status Code. The ACK Status identifies the outcome of recipient processing (Accepted, Rejected, Conflict, No Participation, etc.), while the Validation Message explains the reason for that outcome. Validation Messages are derived from CWR MSG records and typically contain the affected CWR record type, validation severity, validation identifier, and explanatory text. In Tempo, these MSG components are stored as a concatenated string within song_ack_message_tx and must be parsed to expose the underlying structure. Validation Messages are authoritative for troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, recipient-specific issue identification, and registration-quality investigations.

Business Definition: Administrative or processing notification associated with a Song, optionally including an attachment. The Active (Y/N) indicator was added to the Tempo database in December 2022.
Business Context / Rule: The view may return one row per alert and attachment combination. Confirm attachment cardinality before counting alerts.

Business Definition: User-created reusable grouping of Songs or Productions for reporting and filtering.
Business Context / Rule: Reporting Groups are reusable user-defined filters and may form a many-to-many relationship with Songs.

Business Definition: Active royalty-calculation allocation connecting a Song, Payment Option, Office Group, Client, Contract, and Subcontract.
Business Context / Rule: Allocation percentages within the applicable allocation group should not exceed 100%, but they do not need to total 100%. Exact composite grain remains under validation.

Business Definition: Status associated with an alternate title.
Business Context / Rule: Do not assign a business interpretation until the status and date semantics are confirmed.

Business Definition: Date associated with the source or effective history of an identifier.
Business Context / Rule: Do not use as an effective date or creation date until the source-specific meaning is confirmed.

Business Definition: Commercial agreement structure defining rights and share arrangements across rights and income groups.
Business Context / Rule: Use Agreement within the documented Subject Area and at the grain of the related asset (agreements_detailed_rights_v).

Business Definition: Grouping of rights and income categories within an Agreement.
Business Context / Rule: Use Agreement Rights Group within the documented Subject Area and at the grain of the related asset (agreement_rights_group_id).

Business Definition: Tempo party to whom royalty, contractual, and financial activity is attributed.
Business Context / Rule: Use Client within the documented Subject Area and at the grain of the related asset (client_v).

Business Definition: Royalty-settlement rollup Client receiving consolidated transactions and determining the ultimate payable and Client-facing statement position.
Business Context / Rule: Use for royalty settlement and Client-facing payable/statement position. This is different from the P&L Grouping Client.

Business Definition: Internal financial-reporting rollup used for advances, recoupment, write-offs, and deal financial analysis; it does not affect Client Statements. This data point is maintained by the US Deal Modeling team and is owned by Tom Foley
Business Context / Rule: Use for internal deal-financial reporting, advances, recoupment, and write-offs. It does not change Client Statements or payments.

Business Definition: Classification describing the role or business nature of a Client.
Business Context / Rule: Use Client Type within the documented Subject Area and at the grain of the related asset (client_type_id).

Business Definition: Legal and commercial agreement governing administration, collection, royalty calculation, and payment terms.
Business Context / Rule: Contract terms govern administration, collection, calculation, and payment; use the current Contract record for current-state reporting.

Business Definition: Alternate business name used to identify a Contract.
Business Context / Rule: Use Contract AKA within the documented Subject Area and at the grain of the related asset (contract_aka_nm).

Business Definition: Detailed royalty-calculation structure beneath a Contract, including rates, periods, source groups, office groups, and income categories.
Business Context / Rule: Rates can vary by royalty period, office group, source group, and income type/group. Respect the full rate grain before selecting a rate.

Business Definition: Date on which the Contract becomes effective.
Business Context / Rule: Use Contract Commencement Date within the documented Subject Area and at the grain of the related asset (contract_commencement_dt).

Business Definition: Date on which the contractual term ends.
Business Context / Rule: Use Contract Expiration Date within the documented Subject Area and at the grain of the related asset (contract_expiration_dt).

Business Definition: Post-expiration period during which SMP retains administration, control, and collection rights.
Business Context / Rule: Applies after Contract expiration and represents the period SMP retains administration, control, and collection rights.

Business Definition: Months after Contract expiration during which SMP may continue collecting royalties from sources.
Business Context / Rule: Applies after Contract expiration and represents the period SMP may continue collecting income from sources.

Business Definition: Contract term extending for the duration of copyright protection.
Business Context / Rule: Use Life of Copyright within the documented Subject Area and at the grain of the related asset (life_of_copyright_ind).

Business Definition: Unclaimed or unallocated royalty pools that may be distributed to eligible Clients.
Business Context / Rule: Allocation is limited to eligible Clients and depends on the relevant Black Box process and pool.

Business Definition: Indicates contractual eligibility for Black Box allocations; it does not guarantee an allocation.
Business Context / Rule: Y indicates contractual eligibility only; it does not guarantee that a Black Box allocation will be made.

Business Definition: Operational Royalties-team grouping used to batch Clients for statement and payment processing.
Business Context / Rule: Use for operational batching of statements and payments, not as a financial or administrative ownership hierarchy.

Business Definition: Monthly, quarterly, or semiannual Client statement and payment cadence.
Business Context / Rule: Determines the normal Client statement and payment cadence.

Business Definition: Entity designated to receive royalty payments for one or more Clients.
Business Context / Rule: A Client can have multiple Payees, and a Payee can receive payments for multiple Clients.

Business Definition: Many-to-many relationship: a Client may have multiple Payees, and a Payee may receive payments for multiple Clients.
Business Context / Rule: Treat as many-to-many. Do not infer a single Payee per Client or a single Client per Payee.

Business Definition: Percentage of an income stream SMP is contractually entitled to collect for a Client.
Business Context / Rule: Applied to determine the portion of an income stream SMP is contractually entitled to collect.

Business Definition: Intercompany rate determining the amount retained or remitted by the collecting affiliate.
Business Context / Rule: For intercompany income, this rate governs the amount passed between the processing affiliate and the Client/deal office.

Business Definition: Percentage of available income calculated as royalty payable to the Client.
Business Context / Rule: Applied after the applicable income basis is established to calculate Client Royalty Payable.

Business Definition: Calculation methodology applied to royalty income: At Source, Receipt, Limited Receipt, or Participant.
Business Context / Rule: Rate Type controls the royalty-calculation basis. Rate Type 4 is Participant and has special reporting treatment.

Business Definition: Restriction attached to a Contract that may affect processing, payment, or reporting.
Business Context / Rule: A Contract hold can restrict processing or payment; interpret together with the hold code/text and applicable workflow.

Business Definition: Restriction attached to a Client that may affect royalty processing or payment.
Business Context / Rule: A Client hold can restrict royalty processing or payment; distinguish it from Payee and Earnings-level holds.

Business Definition: Accounting-period ledger balance and financial movements for an individual Client.
Business Context / Rule: Use at Client plus Accounting Period grain. Avoid joining to lower-grain transactions without controlling duplication.

Business Definition: Statement-period balance, earnings, payments, and payable position for a Client and Payee.
Business Context / Rule: Use at Client, Payee, Statement Period, and Run Group grain.

Business Definition: Financial position by P&L Grouping Client used for advance, recoupment, reserve, recovery, and write-off reporting.
Business Context / Rule: Use at P&L Grouping Client and capitalized accounting-period grain for advance, reserve, recovery, and recoupment reporting.

Business Definition: Balance carried into the beginning of an accounting or statement period.
Business Context / Rule: Represents the position before current-period activity; reconcile to the prior period Closing Balance where applicable.

Business Definition: Balance remaining after applying activity for the applicable period.
Business Context / Rule: Represents Opening Balance plus or minus current-period movements according to the applicable balance process.

Business Definition: Amount eligible to be paid to the Client or Payee for a statement period.
Business Context / Rule: Payment eligibility can be affected by Payee holds and other operational controls.

Business Definition: Contractual payment made before sufficient royalty earnings have been generated.
Business Context / Rule: Advances are generally recouped from eligible future earnings according to Contract terms.

Business Definition: Process of applying eligible earnings against an outstanding advance or recoupable balance.
Business Context / Rule: Apply only eligible earnings and rates according to the governing Contract/Subcontract configuration.

Business Definition: Calculated royalties attributed to a Client during an accounting or statement period.
Business Context / Rule: Use Royalty Earnings within the documented Subject Area and at the grain of the related asset (earnings_am).

Business Definition: Calculated earnings prevented from normal payment or statement processing because of a hold.
Business Context / Rule: Held earnings should not be treated as immediately payable until the applicable hold is released.

Business Definition: Net Publisher Share retained by the deal-originating office or affiliate.
Business Context / Rule: For deal financial reporting, NPS belongs to the deal-originating office or affiliate.

Business Definition: NPS retained by a collecting or processing affiliate before intercompany remittance.
Business Context / Rule: Represents NPS retained by the collecting or processing affiliate before intercompany remittance.

Business Definition: Indicates payment is blocked because the associated Payee is on hold.
Business Context / Rule: Y indicates payment is blocked because the associated Payee is on hold.

Business Definition: Amount withheld from otherwise available balances; detailed movement definitions remain pending.
Business Context / Rule: Do not finalize reserve movement logic until opening, movement, cumulative, and closing definitions are validated.

Business Definition: Amount recovered against a prior reserve or financial adjustment; detailed calculation remains pending.
Business Context / Rule: Do not finalize recovery reporting until the relationship to reserves and cumulative recovery is validated.

Business Definition: Financial amount whose business definition remains pending.
Business Context / Rule: Definition remains open; do not assign to a financial category without SME confirmation.

Business Definition: Financial amount whose business definition remains pending.
Business Context / Rule: Definition remains open; do not combine with Soft Crossing until the distinction is confirmed.

Business Definition: Financial amount whose meaning and distinction from Crossing remain pending.
Business Context / Rule: Definition remains open; report separately from Crossing Amount until validated.

Business Definition: Closing capitalized financial position; precise component formula remains pending.
Business Context / Rule: Do not derive or reconcile a formula until all contributing components are confirmed.

Business Definition: Paying society, licensee, DSP, affiliate, or other organization supplying royalty income and transaction information.
Business Context / Rule: Source-level configuration can affect loading, matching, identifier overrides, digital treatment, and recoupment.

Business Definition: Additional source classification beneath the primary Royalty Source.
Business Context / Rule: Use beneath the primary Source to describe more specific royalty streams or reporting channels.

Business Definition: A royalty statement received from an external source and loaded into Tempo for processing. A Statement Header represents the administrative and reporting container for a group of royalty transactions received from a common source and statement period. Statement Headers provide the contextual information required to process, classify, reconcile, and report royalty earnings, including statement dates, source relationships, currency information, processing status, and other statement-level attributes associated with the underlying Earnings Lines.
Business Context / Rule: A Statement Header groups related royalty transactions before they are allocated, processed, and reported within Tempo. The same statement_header_id may exist in multiple Processing Offices and therefore should not be treated as globally unique. The business identifier for a Statement Header is the combination of Processing Office ID + Statement Header ID. Statement Headers serve as a key reporting dimension for royalty analysis because they preserve the external statement structure received from societies, affiliates, licensees, digital service providers, and other royalty sources. When earnings are summarized at Statement Header level, financial totals should reconcile to equivalent earnings summarized at Song level when aggregated to a common reporting grain.

Business Definition: Overall processing state of a Statement Header.
Business Context / Rule: Use the approved status domain; Header status does not replace individual Statement Line status.

Business Definition: Raw royalty transaction received from a paying source before SMP royalty calculations.
Business Context / Rule: Statement Lines contain raw source royalty data. Royalty calculations occur when Earnings Lines are created.

Business Definition: Processing status assigned to an individual Statement Line through matching, calculation, release, finalization, return, void, or reversal.
Business Context / Rule: Use the approved status domain to distinguish matching, calculation, release, finalization, return, void, and reversal states.

Business Definition: Statement Line not yet matched to a Tempo Song or Work.
Business Context / Rule: Requires matching before normal royalty calculation can proceed.

Business Definition: Statement Line associated with a Tempo Song or Work.
Business Context / Rule: A successful match identifies the Tempo Song/Work, but does not by itself indicate calculation or finalization.

Business Definition: Statement Line that passed through royalty calculation.
Business Context / Rule: Calculation has occurred, but review the status and finalization indicator to determine whether processing is complete.

Business Definition: Statement Line that completed calculation and generated one or more Earnings Lines.
Business Context / Rule: sl_finalized=Y indicates calculation completed and one or more Earnings Lines were created.

Business Definition: Error encountered when applying royalty-calculation rules to a Statement Line.
Business Context / Rule: Requires correction or exception handling before normal finalization.

Business Definition: Not Valid For Territory; a territory-related calculation error indicating SMP lacks a valid claim.
Business Context / Rule: Use when SMP lacks a valid territorial claim for the Song and reported royalty. It is a territory-related Calc Error.

Business Definition: Statement Line determined not to represent an SMP-controlled or administered claim.
Business Context / Rule: Use when the royalty is determined not to belong to SMP-controlled or administered repertoire.

Business Definition: Workflow stage indicating a Statement Line is approved or being prepared for Earnings creation.
Business Context / Rule: Represents approval or preparation to move a Statement Line into Earnings creation.

Business Definition: Statement Line successfully released into calculated Earnings processing.
Business Context / Rule: Indicates the Statement Line was released into Earnings processing.

Business Definition: Source-supplied work or recording information matched to a Tempo Song through automated or manual matching.
Business Context / Rule: Use to trace source-supplied work/recording attributes to the matched Tempo Song and matching evidence.

Business Definition: Classification of matching method or confidence hierarchy.
Business Context / Rule: Do not compare or rank matching quality until the value domain and hierarchy are validated.

Business Definition: Official process and record for actual cash receipts received by an affiliate.
Business Context / Rule: Only physically received cash is recorded. Royalty-related CRJ lines are associated with Statement Headers and drive accounting entries.

Business Definition: Group of Cash Receipt Journal lines submitted and reconciled together.
Business Context / Rule: Batch totals should be reconciled across the related CRJ Lines before posting to the General Ledger.

Business Definition: Individual cash receipt within a CRJ Batch.
Business Context / Rule: Use the Batch plus Line key to identify an individual cash receipt record.

Business Definition: Relationship connecting a royalty cash receipt to a Statement Header.
Business Context / Rule: A cash receipt may be associated to royalty Statement Headers through association records; do not assume a simple one-to-one relationship.

Business Definition: Statement Header release-control field whose business rule remains pending.
Business Context / Rule: Do not use as an approved release control until the business rule is confirmed.

Business Definition: Source-level percentage associated with recoupment processing; detailed use remains pending.
Business Context / Rule: Do not use in recoupment calculations until the source-level application rule is confirmed.

Business Definition: Calculated royalty allocation generated from a finalized Statement Line; one Statement Line may generate multiple Earnings Lines.
Business Context / Rule: One finalized Statement Line can create multiple Earnings Lines across Clients, Contracts, Rates, or Offices.

Business Definition: Earnings Line viewed from the office that received and processed the royalty.
Business Context / Rule: Use this perspective to analyze where income was received and processed.

Business Definition: Earnings represented from the Client or deal-owning office perspective after intercompany processing.
Business Context / Rule: Use this perspective to analyze the Client/deal office economics after intercompany processing.

Business Definition: Office responsible for receiving and processing royalty income.
Business Context / Rule: The processing office receives and calculates the royalty and may retain Processing Office NPS.

Business Definition: Office associated with the underlying Client or deal.
Business Context / Rule: The originating office owns the Client/deal relationship and receives intercompany income after applicable retention.

Business Definition: Source royalty amount converted into the currency or basis used by royalty calculation.
Business Context / Rule: This is the amount used as the royalty-calculation basis after source-level conversion and deductions.

Business Definition: Allocation percentage attributable to a Client interest.
Business Context / Rule: Apply within the correct Song, payment option, office group, Client, Contract, and Subcontract context.

Business Definition: Contractual percentage SMP is entitled to collect.
Business Context / Rule: Derived from Contract/Subcontract setup and used with Song Share to establish the Income Ratio.

Business Definition: Song Share percentage multiplied by Contract Collectable percentage.
Business Context / Rule: Income Ratio = Song Share Percentage × Contract Collectable Percentage.

Business Definition: Income Ratio recalculated at the Client/deal office after intercompany splitting.
Business Context / Rule: Can differ from the processing-office Income Ratio after intercompany splitting and may become 100% at an individual originating office.

Business Definition: Converted Net Amount multiplied by Income Ratio before applying the Client royalty rate.
Business Context / Rule: Gross Client Share of Income = Converted Net Amount × Income Ratio. Participant Rate Type 4 rows must not add this amount independently.

Business Definition: Client Rate for same-office income or Affiliate Remittance Rate for intercompany income.
Business Context / Rule: Use Client Rate for same-office income and Affiliate Remittance Rate for intercompany income.

Business Definition: Amount payable to the Client or passed intercompany to the Client office.
Business Context / Rule: Represents the amount due to the Client or passed intercompany to the Client office.

Business Definition: NPS retained by the processing affiliate.
Business Context / Rule: Retained by the office processing the royalty.

Business Definition: NPS attributed to the Client/deal-owning office.
Business Context / Rule: Attributed to the Client/deal office after intercompany processing.

Business Definition: NPS retained by the foreign processing affiliate before intercompany remittance.
Business Context / Rule: Represents NPS retained by the collecting or processing affiliate before intercompany remittance.

Business Definition: Amount posted to the General Ledger, normally Royalty Payable plus NPS; zero for Participant Rate Type.
Business Context / Rule: Normally Royalty Payable + NPS. For Participant Rate Type 4, the posting amount must be zero to avoid double counting.

Business Definition: Royalty calculation based on income at the original source level.
Business Context / Rule: Uses the original source-level income basis for royalty calculation.

Business Definition: Royalty calculation based on income received by the applicable affiliate.
Business Context / Rule: Uses income received by the applicable affiliate as the royalty-calculation basis.

Business Definition: Modified or restricted Receipt-based royalty calculation.
Business Context / Rule: Uses a restricted or modified Receipt-based calculation according to the configured terms.

Business Definition: Client used for override, refund, joint venture, BIEM Writer, or similar arrangements, inheriting economics from Primary Clients.
Business Context / Rule: Participant economics are inherited from associated Primary Clients. The Participant line carries Client Royalty Payable only.

Business Definition: Client holding the underlying Song share and economic calculation from which Participant allocations derive.
Business Context / Rule: Holds the underlying share and economic calculation that supports Participant allocation.

Business Definition: Earnings Line carrying Participant royalty payable without independently carrying Gross Income or NPS.
Business Context / Rule: Do not include as additional Gross Income, NPS, or GL revenue. Include only the Participant Royalty Payable.

Business Definition: Indicates that an Earnings Line is tied to a Participant Client on the linked Song.
Business Context / Rule: Y means the Earnings Line is tied to a Participant Client on the linked Song.

Business Definition: Rule excluding Rate Type 4 lines from additional Gross Income, NPS, and GL revenue to prevent double counting.
Business Context / Rule: Exclude Rate Type 4 from independent Gross Income, NPS, and GL Posting aggregation to prevent double counting.

Business Definition: Indicates an Earnings Line has been included on a Client royalty statement.
Business Context / Rule: Y means the Earnings Line was included on a Client royalty statement.

Business Definition: Identifier linking Earnings Lines in multiple scenarios; it is not exclusive to Participant processing.
Business Context / Rule: Do not assume this field only represents Participant lineage. It is used in additional processing scenarios that remain under validation.

Business Definition: Hold preventing an Earnings Line from normal accounting or statement processing.
Business Context / Rule: Keep separate from Client, Contract, and Payee holds until the workflow relationship is defined.

Business Definition: Classification of an Earnings reversal.
Business Context / Rule: Do not classify reversal behavior until the code domain is documented.

Business Definition: Accounting indicator whose formal business definition remains pending.
Business Context / Rule: Do not use to infer accounting timing until the formal definition is confirmed.

Business Definition: Synchronization licensing transaction created and managed through the Tempo Sync Licensing module.
Business Context / Rule: Only transactions created through the Tempo Sync Licensing module are included.

Business Definition: Tempo workflow for synchronization licenses; Mechanical and other licensing use separate modules and source tables.
Business Context / Rule: Mechanical, Karaoke, Ringtone, Digital Usage, and other licensing processes can use separate modules and source tables.

Business Definition: Tempo identifier for a Sync License.
Business Context / Rule: Use as the primary license transaction identifier in sync_licensing_v, subject to final grain confirmation.

Business Definition: Identifier linking a license to a primary or related license; relationship semantics remain pending.
Business Context / Rule: Do not assume parent-child semantics until the relationship is validated.

Business Definition: Classification of licensed use; only License Types with sync_ind=Y are valid in the module.
Business Context / Rule: Only License Types where sync_ind=Y can be created through the Sync Licensing module.

Business Definition: Commercial, licensing, payment, or lifecycle status of a Sync opportunity or agreement.
Business Context / Rule: Use the approved nine-value domain to distinguish pipeline, licensed, payment, closed, and exception outcomes.

Business Definition: Opportunity has been presented or proposed.
Business Context / Rule: Represents an opportunity presented or proposed before formal licensing completion.

Business Definition: Licensing terms or pricing have been provided.
Business Context / Rule: Terms or pricing have been provided; this does not mean the License is executed.

Business Definition: License request is pending required approval.
Business Context / Rule: Required approval remains outstanding before licensing can proceed.

Business Definition: License has been granted or executed.
Business Context / Rule: The License has been granted or executed; payment may still be outstanding.

Business Definition: License has been granted and payment received.
Business Context / Rule: The License has been granted and payment received.

Business Definition: License request was rejected.
Business Context / Rule: The licensing request was rejected.

Business Definition: Opportunity is no longer active.
Business Context / Rule: The opportunity is inactive and is not expected to proceed.

Business Definition: Payment is not expected to be collected.
Business Context / Rule: The License or receivable exists, but payment is not expected to be collected.

Business Definition: License fee or related transaction has been credited or adjusted.
Business Context / Rule: The License fee or related transaction was credited or adjusted.

Business Definition: Specific exploitation right requested, negotiated, cleared, or granted through a Sync License.

Business Definition: Geographic territory or country where licensed rights apply.
Business Context / Rule: The field is display-oriented and can combine included and excluded Territories and Countries.

Business Definition: Territory expressly included within licensed scope.
Business Context / Rule: Indicates geography expressly granted within the License.

Business Definition: Territory expressly excluded from licensed scope.

Business Definition: Company receiving the licensed rights.

Business Context / Rule: Responsible for payment/invoicing and may differ from the Licensee and Clearance Company.

Business Definition: SMP entity issuing or managing the Sync License.
Business Context / Rule: Represents the SMP entity issuing or managing the License.

Business Definition: Company grouping used for accrual reporting.
Business Context / Rule: Use for accrual reporting according to the assigned Company Group.

Business Definition: Audiovisual or other production in which the Song will be used.
Business Context / Rule: Represents the production using the Song, not necessarily the Song or master title.

Business Definition: Percentage of the composition licensed by SMP.

Business Context / Rule: Represents SMP gross share of the License Fee.

Business Context / Rule: Populate and interpret only when Master Use Indicator=Y.

Business Definition: Structured or staged payment arrangement associated with a Sync License.
Business Context / Rule: Indicates a structured or staged payment schedule rather than a single payment event.

Business Definition: Date the License Fee is contractually due.

Business Definition: Date payment was received.

Business Definition: Rate associated with a Sync License; precise definition remains pending.

Business Definition: NPS recorded in Sync License Summary; relationship to License Fee and SAMP Income remains pending.

Business Definition: Grouping applied to Licensee, Clearance Company, or Invoice Party contact; purpose remains pending.

Business Definition: Term used within several All Media Sync Rights Types; expansion and definition remain pending.

Business Definition: Natural person represented in Tempo as an interested party in musical works, including names, industry identifier, and society affiliations.

Business Definition: Legal entity represented for publishing administration, society affiliations, contacts, and Publisher relationships.
